title: Crypto misuse: GCM wc_InitRng_ex error path missing wc_AesFree before kfree
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm_sess_init: when wc_InitRng_ex fails (line 124-128 in wolfssl_aes_gcm.c), wc_AesFree is called but the function then does kfree(ctx) without memzero_explicit. More importantly: this error path correctly calls wc_AesFree (freeing wolfCrypt's internal Aes allocations), but does NOT call memzero_explicit(ctx, sizeof(*ctx)) before kfree. At this point ctx->aes holds the fully-programmed AES-GCM key schedule (wc_AesGcmSetKey succeeded). The embedded Aes struct in ctx contains the expanded key tables. kfree without memzero_explicit leaves the key schedule in freed kernel heap memory. This is distinct from issue WOLFKM-tp5.16 in specificity: this is the wc_InitRng_ex path which is the most likely to actually fail (entropy unavailable at module load time) and has the highest severity because the full key schedule is in ctx->aes.
close_reason: Duplicate of WOLFKM-tp5.16 which covers all three GCM sess_init error paths
